a.lede: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.
a.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts

b.lede: Hackers around the world are all-in on using agentic AI to wage attacks—and manipulating tools like Anthropic’s Claude to help them carry out their crimes.
b.title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
